name: apple_search_ads-mcp
display_name: Apple Ads (formerly Apple Search Ads) MCP
description: Apple Ads (formerly Apple Search Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_b

platform_mcp_apple_search_ads_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLE_SEARCH_ADS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_apple_search_ads_client_id.description: Apple Ads API clientId (SEARCHADS.…) shown after uploading your public key under Account Settings > API (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/apple-ads-platform-api/implementing-oauth-for-the-apple-ads-platform-api).

platform_mcp_apple_search_ads_client_sec.title: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLE_SEARCH_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_apple_search_ads_client_sec.description: The client secret JWT you sign yourself with your ES256 private key (header kid=keyId; claims sub=clientId, iss=teamId, aud=https://appleid.apple.com, exp at most 180 days after iat). The runtime does not sign it: regenerate and replace it before it expires.

platform_mcp_apple_search_ads_ap_context.title: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLE_SEARCH_ADS_AP_CONTEXT
platform_mcp_apple_search_ads_ap_context.description: The full X-AP-Context header value for ad-account-scoped calls, exactly `adAccountId=<ad account id>` (ids from GET /v1/acls, i.e. list_accounts).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/me: {result: {userId, orgId}} of the API user.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /v1/acls: ad accounts the token can manage with the user's roles (raw.roles). Put the chosen id in the ap_context config as adAccountId=<id>.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: POST /v1/campaigns/query {pagination: {offset, pageSize, fetchTotalCount: true}} in the ad account named by the ap_context config (X-AP-Context header); account_id is not sent and `status` is not applied (filter raw.status: ENABLED / PAUSED). `budget` is the daily budget amount (a decimal string).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: POST /v1/reports/apps/campaigns/query {filters: [{field: campaignId, operator: EQUALS, value}], timeRange: {start, end, timeZone: ORTZ}}: App Store campaign totals over the range. Apple requires a campaignId filter on every apps report, so pass campaign_id. Daily granularMetrics are not requested (DAILY needs a start within the last 90 days).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PUT /v1/campaigns/{id} {dailyBudget: {value: {amount, currency}}} (partial update): changes the daily spend limit of a live campaign. Pass `currency` (the ad account currency).
